rationale: One four-image country pair followed by four three-image country pairs uses each of the sixteen remaining selected assets exactly once, preserving older single-image leftovers without filler.
remainingGate: Historical audit has 219 of 234 posts fully reviewed, with 17 remaining photo views. Fresh X account, source, caption, alt-text, AI-label, duplicate, Git/LFS and PR checks are still required before any Post.
hashtagState: Not rolled or reserved. Apply the existing independent 25-percent rules once when the exact post is reserved, retaining the first deterministic results.
